title: Audit infrastructure separation, privileged roles and protection alerts need evidence
remediation: Deployment logging and identity owners review the audit store topology and approved separation frequency. Verify the store is on a physically different system or component where required. Review the privileged roles authorized to administer logging, and the separate read-only roles. Test allowed reads, denied changes and deletions, and delivery of unauthorized-change alerts through an approved exercise. Component maintainers preserve scoped file permission evidence and investigate missing protection.

milestones.title: Collect approved topology and privileged role assignments, redacted access checks, and a verified unauthorized-change alert receipt
